about_the_game:
🦅 ABOUT THE GAME

Step into the feathered skins of winged avengers whose world has been taken over by greedy monsters! Mad Birds is an explosive mix of:

  • Flawless destruction physics (every brick is calculated with surgical precision)

  • Tactical shots (where trajectory is an art and chaos is your ally)

  • Crazy fun (the game can cause childish delight in adults)

🎯 FEATURES

Mad Birds is a casual physics-based game in which the player uses a slingshot to launch birds at enemies and various buildings and destroy them. Enemies can be destroyed both by direct hits and by buildings falling on them.

✧ 160+ levels with cinematic destruction - from flimsy glass boxes to stone castles.

✧ 4 seasons in different styles are available.

✧ Get the maximum number of stars and take first place in the leaderboard.

✧ Accumulate energy for completing levels and spend it on various bonuses.

✧ New levels and seasons are added regularly.

✧ 5 disaster birds with superpowers:

  • Explosive bird (blows up everything, including the 4th wall)

  • Speed bird (accelerates to the speed of a meme)

  • Triple bird (yes, it has a personality disorder)

  • and more!

🎨 STYLE

A bright cartoon world where every frame is like eye candy.

Try to complete all the levels and earn the maximum number of stars!
